items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Oh yeah we were good friends. He was one of the fellas that used to go fishin'.

ctx.x: You did another date in 1944 with Coleman Hawkins. Did you know Coleman Hawkins well.

Oh yeah we were good friends. He was one of the fellas that used to go fishin'. He'd go fishin'. Man I took him fishin' one time and the next time I know this cat had about 500 dollars worth of fishin' stuff & he didn't even know which way it go. . . . He had money. He had a hell of a train set. A lot of people didn't know. A train, man, ran a couple rooms it was a real train--miniature, but it was a train set.
